description: This source file contains implementation of graph utility functions for the Torch JIT compiler, including functions to infer tensor types, shape and type inference for inputs, and setting input tensor types within a computational graph.

methods.name: TypePtr getTensorType(const at::Tensor & t,bool complete)
methods.description: Creates a tensor type from a given tensor, optionally marking it as complete or dimensioned only.

methods.name: TypePtr inferShapeAndTypeForInput(TypePtr input_type,Stack::const_iterator & s_iter,const Stack::const_iterator & s_iter_end,bool complete)
methods.description: Recursively infers the shape and type of an input based on its declared type and current stack iterator position, handling composite types such as tuples, lists, and optionals.

methods.name: void setInputTensorTypes(Graph & g,const Stack & stack,bool complete,const std::vector<int> & param_count_list)
methods.description: Sets the types for the inputs of a given graph based on the provided stack and parameter counts, handling special cases for named types with custom classes.
